name: io.github.leonardosepulvedat/mcp-google-analytics
description: GA4 MCP that reads AND writes: reports, funnels, audits, and server-side events. 26 tools.

environmentVariables.name: GA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
environmentVariables.description: To read reports: path to the service account JSON key, or the JSON itself

environmentVariables.name: GA_PROPERTY_ID
environmentVariables.description: To read reports: numeric Property ID from GA4 Admin, e.g. 123456789

environmentVariables.name: GA_MEASUREMENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only to send events: Measurement ID, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX

environmentVariables.name: GA_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only to send events: Measurement Protocol API secret
